tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text: During the process of electro refining of copper, some metals present as impurity settle down as anode mud. These are:

options.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></math>  and  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi></math>

solution.text: In anode mud, less electropositive elements are present.  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math>  and  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi></math>  are less electropositive than  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi></math> .
